board: PH-4502C pH sensor module with E-201-C BNC pH probe (6-pin To/Do/Po/G/G/V+ header)
reason: Analog-sensor model of the Po output (2.5 V at pH 7, rising ~0.18 V/pH as pH falls) with a driver doing median ADC sampling, Nernst temperature scaling of the slope and two-point buffer calibration; check passed on ESP32 and Pico (3.05 V -> pH 3.9). No manufacturer datasheet exists for this clone board, so specs and pin order come from the vendor listing and an Arduino forum thread.
